matched_atoms.quote: Other developers use the API to create natural language interfaces that are then consumed by *end users* (or act as both developers and end users themselves).

max_clause.text: **Developer**: a customer of the OpenAI API. Some developers use the API to add intelligence to their software applications, in which case the output of the assistant is consumed by an application, and is typically required to follow a precise format. Other developers use the API to create natural language interfaces that are then consumed by *end users* (or act as both developers and end users themselves).
